Maya Chen: I need a quick swap — flight delay and won't make the overnight shift, can someone take primary starting in ~20m? I'm currently primary for the pager and the customer-facing retry spike runbook is already loaded.
Jon Patel: I can do first 2 hours if needed. What's the current customer impact?
Maya Chen: Right now a subset of requests to embeddings-api are seeing increased 503s (rate limiter tripping). Dashboard shows error rate ~4% for EU region. Not full outage but PST customers have started to message support.
incident-bot: [ALERT] Embeddings API 503 spike detected — error-rate: 4.1% (5m avg). Pager: #critical-embed (pager sent to rotation). Link: https://internal/alerts/3755550001
Priya Singh: @Maya can you hand off the quick mitigation steps? I can take full primary for the overnight if Jon can shadow as secondary.
Maya Chen: TL;DR: we're hitting a rate limiter regression after deploy earlier. Short mitigation: flip to the fallback model shard and temporarily increase tenant rate soft-limit for high-throughput clients. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/embed-503 (see section 'soft rollback + tenant bump').
Maya Chen: runbook snippet: ```# temp bump command
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/tenants/adjust-rate -d '{"tenant":"high-throughput","limit":2000}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```
Maya Chen: Also disable the new batching optimizer: `rbctl set-config embeddings.batch_optimizer.enabled false` — that was the change that correlated with the spike.
Sam Torres: I can patch the tenant bump and monitor metrics for the next 15m, then hand to Priya if stable.
Jon Patel: Good plan. If Sam is on it I'll be secondary and keep watch on on-call channel + traces. Priya, want me to run the rollback if we see variance?
Priya Singh: Yes please, Jon — have the rollback cmd ready. Put the rollback snippet in this thread so oncall-bot can pick it up.
oncall-bot: Ack — monitoring watchlist created for thread 3755550001. Auto-notify @rotation in 15m if error rate >3%
Maya Chen: Rollback snippet: ```# rollback batching optimizer
rbctl set-config embeddings.batch_optimizer.enabled true --rollback-to previous
# or deploy orchestration:
deployctl rollback embeddings-service --to-revision v2.14.3
```
Sam Torres: Done the tenant bump and flipped optimizer off. Metrics: error-rate down to 1.2% (2m avg), 95th latency improved a bit. I'm watching logs for any new 5xx.
Priya Singh: Nice. Sam, can you stay primary for another 25m while I finish a customer email draft? I'll take over after if things stay green.
Sam Torres: Yep staying. Jon, can you run the smoke traces and check for any reroute errors?
Jon Patel: Running smoke now — results: majority ok, one trace shows a fallback model selection but no 5xx. Will post a few trace IDs: `trace-3755-1`, `trace-3755-2`.
Maya Chen: I'm going to update the incident ticket with mitigation steps and note a postmortem if we need one. Thanks all. @Priya copy me on the customer note once it's ready.
Priya Singh: Will do. Draft: "We briefly observed increased errors for embeddings in EU due to a rate-limiter regression after a recent optimizer flag change. We implemented a temporary tenant limit increase and disabled the optimizer, which reduced errors. We're monitoring and will follow up with actions to prevent recurrence." Thoughts?
Jon Patel: Good concise note. Add estimated window: started ~3755549900 -> mitigated by 3755550040.
Priya Singh: Updated. Posting to support channel now.
incident-bot: [INFO] Pager resolved for thread 3755550001 — status: mitigated. Followups: postmortem? yes/no prompt in 2h.
Sam Torres: Passing primary to Priya in 20m as planned. I'll leave a watchlist alert pinned.
Priya Singh: Taking primary at 3755550110. Thanks Sam/Jon/Maya. I'll escalate to PM if errors reappear.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — appreciate the quick handoff. I'm available if any rollback needs to be executed.
Jon Patel: On standby as secondary. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Closing thread for now, will update if anything changes.
